name: dictate-long
reference: I want to review the changes before we release the new version. First, check that the settings menu shows both speech models and remembers the selection after a restart. Next, record a short message with the microphone and compare the transcript with what was spoken. Repeat the same check with a longer recording. We should measure the time after the recording stops, because that delay affects the user. Memory usage matters as well, especially when other applications are running. If a transcription is cancelled, the application must stop the pending work and allow another recording. Write down the results and explain which model you would choose for daily dictation.
